segment: Founders and small marketing teams; hypothesis
value_metric: Platform access plus retail USD generation allowance and active content-channel capacity

wtp_evidence: None; interviews and paid cohort evidence required
uncertainty: Retention, support costs, publishing fees and hosted margin unknown
experiment: Comprehension and bounded paid-retention pilot only after billing implementation
